subject: English
standard_text_kind: Source-aligned paraphrases; not a verbatim transcription

content_standards.1.1: Respond suitably to spoken input for different purposes.
content_standards.1.2: Develop pronunciation, stress, rhythm and intonation through listening.
content_standards.1.4: Understand and respond to spoken stories, visual material and songs or rhymes.
content_standards.2.1: Recognise, remember and comprehend vocabulary and short phrases through reading.

learning_standards.1.1.1: Listen and give an appropriate response to a stimulus.
learning_standards.1.4.1(iii): Demonstrate listening comprehension by answering Wh-questions.
learning_standards.2.1.3: Read and show comprehension of vocabulary and short phrases.

release_scope: RPH only, Unit 1; independent practice; Activity Book page mapping and annual RPT not claimed.

lessons.title: School song – Welcome Back
lessons.objective: Sing along at three target-word cues in the school song with appropriate support.
lessons.success_criterion: Sing along at three target-word cues in the school song with appropriate support.
lessons.materials: Textbook p.1, school picture, school bag, two word cards
lessons.induction: Show the school bag and picture; pupils identify school using speech or a picture choice.
lessons.guided: Model the textbook song at a comfortable tempo, pointing to the school picture at the target words.
lessons.practice: Pupils take turns choosing the cue card, then sing the target words at three points in the song.
lessons.support: Use quiet singing, shorter phrases or visual prompts; record non-vocal alternatives separately.
lessons.closure: Pupils select the school picture and recall one target word.
lessons.assessment: Observe each pupil at three singing cues and record successful vocal responses and prompts.
lessons.reflection_criterion: Sing along at three target-word cues in the school song with appropriate support.
lessons.standard_audit: Unit 1: individually checked against textbook pages 1–4 and DSKP printed pages 37, 38, 40, 41 on 2026-11-26; original differentiated classroom activities; no Activity Book page claimed.

lessons.title: School places
lessons.objective: Answer at least four of six spoken Wh-questions about school places using the pictures.
lessons.success_criterion: Answer at least four of six spoken Wh-questions about school places using the pictures.
lessons.materials: Textbook pp.2–3, six original school photo cards, school map
lessons.guided: Ask and model questions about the field, canteen, library, classroom, computer room and hall; link each place to its function.
lessons.practice: Pupils listen to six Wh-questions, answer with speech or picture choices and place the matching cards on a simple map.
lessons.support: Provide two photographs and a sentence starter
lessons.closure: Name a place to visit next
lessons.assessment: Record correct responses to six spoken questions and the type of prompt used.
lessons.reflection_criterion: Answer at least four of six spoken Wh-questions about school places using the pictures.
lessons.standard_audit: Unit 1: individually checked against textbook pages 1–4 and DSKP printed pages 37, 38, 40, 41 on 2026-11-26; original differentiated classroom activities; no Activity Book page claimed.

lessons.title: Reading directions
lessons.objective: Read and act on three of four direction cards and respond to one spoken direction.
lessons.success_criterion: Read and act on three of four direction cards and respond to one spoken direction.
lessons.materials: Textbook p.4, floor arrows, tabletop map, toy figure, direction cards
lessons.induction: Trace a route with a finger
lessons.guided: Model the three direction phrases on the page using the toy figure; read each card and demonstrate its action.
lessons.practice: Pupils read four cards, including one repeated direction, and move the figure to the classroom, canteen or library. Teacher also gives a spoken direction as a separate listening check.
lessons.support: Use arrows beside the printed words; offer seated movement
lessons.closure: Select a route to the library
lessons.assessment: Record correct reading actions out of four and the separate response to the spoken instruction.
lessons.reflection_criterion: Read and act on three of four direction cards and respond to one spoken direction.
lessons.standard_audit: Unit 1: individually checked against textbook pages 1–4 and DSKP printed pages 37, 38, 40, 41 on 2026-11-26; original differentiated classroom activities; no Activity Book page claimed.
